verdict.reasons: The candidate successfully integrates the correct AFP drip-tape product into the requested agricultural setting. The cylinder's geometry is physically consistent, and the product appears in exactly one instance. The installed drip tape laterals align well with the article's technical evidence of 20 cm emitter spacing and neutral seedlings. The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is clearly visible and correct. Minor soil clumping and scattered pebbles are advisory imperfections that do not impact the commercial utility or coherence of the illustration.

focused_physical_review.reason: A black drip irrigation line runs on the soil in the same plane as the carton and visually reaches the package's right base footprint before disappearing behind it, indicating a line crossing/touching the base. The soil around the carton is not a broad uninterrupted gap on all sides due to this line's approach. There is no separate uninstalled loose coil/roll and no protruding tape/strap tail emerging from the package.
